query: dim down my screen because my eyes hurt

siis_response.title: Eye Comfort Shield
siis_response.content: Open Settings. Tap Display. Turn on Eye comfort shield to keep your eyes comfortable by limiting blue light.

query: cut down the juicing of my phone

siis_response.title: Battery Management
siis_response.content: Navigate to Settings. Tap Battery and device care, then tap Battery. Enable Power saving mode to extend battery life.

query: blutooth wont connet turn off

siis_response.title: Bluetooth Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings and tap Connections. Tap Bluetooth and toggle the switch to Off to disable wireless Bluetooth connection.

query: stop disturbing me while I sleep

siis_response.title: Do Not Disturb
siis_response.content: Open Settings. Tap Notifications and select Do not disturb. Toggle the switch to On to silence calls and notifications during sleep.

query: Can you please switch my phone over to flight mode?

siis_response.title: Flight Mode
siis_response.content: Navigate to Settings > Connections. Turn on Airplane mode to turn off all wireless connections on your device.

query: make sure power saving is not active

siis_response.title: Power Saving Mode
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Battery, and turn off Power saving mode to allow maximum device performance.

query: my phone display is way too bright at night

siis_response.title: Display Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings and tap Display. Enable Dark mode to apply a dark theme that is easier on your eyes in low-light environments.

query: disconnet from all wi fi networks now

siis_response.title: Wi-Fi Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Connections, then tap Wi-Fi. Turn the Wi-Fi switch off to disconnect from wireless internet.

query: my phone frame is cracked into two sharp pieces

siis_response.title: Physical Damage Report
siis_response.content: Heavy chassis damage detected. Please visit an authorized service center.

query: my smartphone is smoking and heating up rapidly

siis_response.title: Thermal Emergency
siis_response.content: Disconnect power immediately. Battery thermal failure detected.

query: I would like my battery to stop draining when I am not using the phone

siis_response.title: Put Apps to Sleep
siis_response.content: Open Settings. Tap Battery > Background usage limits. Turn on Put unused apps to sleep to prevent background apps from draining power.

expected_action: Enable Put unused apps to sleep

query: keep the clock visible on screen even when phone is locked

siis_response.title: Always On Display
siis_response.content: Go to Settings and tap Lock screen. Turn on Always On Display to show a clock and notifications when your screen is turned off.

query: turn off always on display clock

siis_response.title: Always On Display
siis_response.content: Navigate to Settings > Lock screen. Turn off Always On Display to conserve power.

query: make incoming calls ring silently with no vibration

siis_response.title: Sound Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Sounds and vibration, and turn off Vibrate while ringing.

query: sync my phone contacts and messages to samsung cloud

siis_response.title: Cloud Backup
siis_response.content: Go to Settings, tap Accounts and backup, and select Back up data to Samsung Cloud to keep your data safe.

query: lock down my device by blocking unauthorized app installs

siis_response.title: Auto Blocker
siis_response.content: In Settings, tap Security and privacy. Tap Auto Blocker and turn it on to protect your device from security threats and unverified apps.

query: turn on wireless networking on my galaxy

siis_response.title: Wi-Fi Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings. Tap Connections, select Wi-Fi, and turn the switch to On.

query: double tap the glass to wake up the screen

siis_response.title: Motions and Gestures
siis_response.content: In Settings, tap Advanced features, tap Motions and gestures, and turn on Double tap to turn on screen.

expected_action: Enable Double tap to turn on screen

query: stop double tap from turning off the screen

siis_response.title: Motions and Gestures
siis_response.content: In Settings, tap Advanced features, select Motions and gestures, and turn off Double tap to turn off screen.

expected_action: Disable Double tap to turn off screen

query: disable flight mode so I get my signal back

siis_response.title: Flight Mode
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Connections, and turn off Airplane mode to restore cellular network access.

query: stop charging the battery past eighty five percent

siis_response.title: Battery Protection
siis_response.content: Open Settings > Battery > Battery protection. Turn on Battery protection to limit maximum charge and extend battery lifespan.

query: show number of unread messages on app icons

siis_response.title: App Icon Badges
siis_response.content: Go to Settings, tap Notifications > Advanced settings, and turn on App icon badges to show notification counts.

query: prevent screen from turning on accidentally in my pocket

siis_response.title: Display Settings
siis_response.content: Open Settings and select Display. Enable Accidental touch protection to prevent inadvertent screen taps in dark places.

query: pair my wireless earbuds with bluetooth

siis_response.title: Bluetooth Settings
siis_response.content: Navigate to Settings > Connections. Tap Bluetooth and turn it on to search for and pair with wireless earbuds.

query: switch the clock from twelve hour to twenty four hour military time

siis_response.title: Date and Time
siis_response.content: Open Settings. Tap General management, tap Date and time, and turn on Use 24-hour format.

query: my battery is draining extremely fast today, help me diagnose it

siis_response.title: Battery Diagnostics
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Battery, and view battery usage details to check which apps are consuming excessive power.

query: make the screen stay awake as long as I am looking at it

siis_response.title: Smart Stay
siis_response.content: In Settings, tap Advanced features, tap Motions and gestures, and enable Keep screen on while viewing.

expected_action: Enable Keep screen on while viewing

query: stop using mobile data when wi-fi is working fine

siis_response.title: Intelligent Wi-Fi
siis_response.content: In Settings, tap Connections > Wi-Fi > More options > Intelligent Wi-Fi. Turn off Switch to mobile data.

query: my phone fell into salt water ocean and won't turn on

siis_response.title: Liquid Damage Emergency
siis_response.content: Severe saltwater corrosion danger. Do not charge phone. Seek immediate service.

query: dim screen automatically in dark rooms

siis_response.title: Display Brightness
siis_response.content: Open Settings, tap Display, and enable Adaptive brightness to adjust screen luminance automatically based on lighting conditions.
